import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import update_registry


class UpdateRegistryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.a = {"id": "a", "label": "A", "level": 1, "cohort": "red"}
        self.b = {"id": "b", "label": "B", "level": 2, "cohort": "blue"}

    def assert_value_error_without_mutation(self, records, operations):
        records_before = deepcopy(records)
        operations_before = deepcopy(operations)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            update_registry(records, operations)
        self.assertEqual(records, records_before)
        self.assertEqual(operations, operations_before)

    def test_operations_apply_in_order_and_preserve_positions(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a), deepcopy(self.b)]
        operations = [
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "label": "AA", "level": 0},
            {
                "action": "add",
                "record": {"id": "c", "label": "C", "level": 3, "cohort": "green"},
            },
            {"action": "remove", "id": "b"},
            {"action": "change", "id": "c", "cohort": "gold"},
        ]
        records_before = deepcopy(records)
        operations_before = deepcopy(operations)

        result = update_registry(records, operations)

        self.assertEqual(
            result,
            [
                {"id": "a", "label": "AA", "level": 0, "cohort": "red"},
                {"id": "c", "label": "C", "level": 3, "cohort": "gold"},
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(records, records_before)
        self.assertEqual(operations, operations_before)
        self.assertIsNot(result, records)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], records[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], operations[1]["record"])

    def test_change_keeps_record_position(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a), deepcopy(self.b)]
        result = update_registry(
            records,
            [{"action": "change", "id": "a", "cohort": "new"}],
        )
        self.assertEqual([record["id"] for record in result], ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["cohort"], "new")

    def test_empty_inputs_and_no_operations(self):
        empty_result = update_registry([], [])
        self.assertEqual(empty_result, [])

        records = [deepcopy(self.a), deepcopy(self.b)]
        result = update_registry(records, [])
        self.assertEqual(result, records)
        self.assertIsNot(result, records)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], records[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], records[1])

    def test_add_and_remove_can_produce_empty_result(self):
        added = {"id": "c", "label": "C", "level": 0, "cohort": ""}
        self.assertEqual(update_registry([], [{"action": "add", "record": added}]), [added])
        self.assertEqual(
            update_registry([deepcopy(self.a)], [{"action": "remove", "id": "a"}]),
            [],
        )

    def test_inputs_remain_unchanged_when_later_operation_fails(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a)]
        operations = [
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "label": "changed"},
            {
                "action": "add",
                "record": {"id": "b", "label": "B", "level": 0, "cohort": "x"},
            },
            {"action": "remove", "id": "missing"},
        ]
        self.assert_value_error_without_mutation(records, operations)

    def test_arguments_must_be_lists(self):
        for records, operations in (
            ((deepcopy(self.a),), []),
            (None, []),
            ([], ()),
            ([], None),
        ):
            with self.subTest(records=records, operations=operations):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    update_registry(records, operations)

    def test_rejects_malformed_initial_records(self):
        good = deepcopy(self.a)
        malformed = [
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"id": "a", "label": "A", "level": 1},
            {"id": "a", "label": "A", "level": 1, "cohort": "x", "extra": 0},
            dict(good, id=""),
            dict(good, id=1),
            dict(good, label=""),
            dict(good, label=1),
            dict(good, level=True),
            dict(good, level=-1),
            dict(good, level=1.0),
            dict(good, cohort=1),
        ]
        for record in malformed:
            with self.subTest(record=record):
                self.assert_value_error_without_mutation([record], [])

    def test_rejects_duplicate_initial_ids(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a), dict(self.a, label="Other")]
        self.assert_value_error_without_mutation(records, [])

    def test_rejects_non_dictionary_or_unknown_action_operations(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a)]
        malformed = [
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"action": None},
            {"action": "noop"},
        ]
        for operation in malformed:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                self.assert_value_error_without_mutation(records, [operation])

    def test_rejects_malformed_add_operations(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a)]
        valid_new_record = {"id": "b", "label": "B", "level": 0, "cohort": ""}
        malformed = [
            {"action": "add"},
            {"action": "add", "record": valid_new_record, "extra": 1},
            {"action": "add", "record": None},
            {
                "action": "add",
                "record": {"id": "b", "label": "", "level": 0, "cohort": ""},
            },
            {
                "action": "add",
                "record": {"id": "b", "label": "B", "level": True, "cohort": ""},
            },
            {
                "action": "add",
                "record": {"id": "a", "label": "Other", "level": 0, "cohort": ""},
            },
        ]
        for operation in malformed:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                self.assert_value_error_without_mutation(records, [operation])

    def test_rejects_malformed_change_operations(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a)]
        malformed = [
            {"action": "change", "id": "a"},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "label": "X", "extra": 1},
            {"action": "change", "id": "missing", "label": "X"},
            {"action": "change", "id": 1, "label": "X"},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "label": ""},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "label": 1},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "level": True},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "level": -1},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "level": 1.0},
            {"action": "change", "id": "a", "cohort": 1},
        ]
        for operation in malformed:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                self.assert_value_error_without_mutation(records, [operation])

    def test_rejects_malformed_remove_operations(self):
        records = [deepcopy(self.a)]
        malformed = [
            {"action": "remove"},
            {"action": "remove", "id": "missing"},
            {"action": "remove", "id": 1},
            {"action": "remove", "id": "a", "extra": 1},
        ]
        for operation in malformed:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                self.assert_value_error_without_mutation(records, [operation])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
